WORDS.guText: Kids plan Pecan Grove in 2035 using every skill. The old farm can hold a data center as planned or with changes, stay a farm, or wait for a study. Every choice can earn full points if every neighbor is heard. In Fulton County, high school students can apply to the county Youth Commission. In Georgia, county plans usually look about 20 years ahead and are updated every five years.
